summary: Resolves a network address or hostname into a string form. If the input name equals the aHostaddr literal (0x005E5064), the in_addr is formatted directly via IPAddressToString; otherwise the address is resolved through DoubleCallWrapper and the char* stored at offset 4 of its result object is returned, falling back to the a3 argument when that result is null.

operations.description: if (!strcmp(a2, aHostaddr)) — name equals the host-address literal
return IPAddressToString(a1) — format the in_addr as a string
v4 = DoubleCallWrapper(a1) — resolve through the wrapper
if (v4 != 0) — wrapper produced a non-null object
return *(char **)(v4 + 4) — read the string pointer stored at offset 4 of the wrapper result
return (char *)a3 — fall back to the caller-provided pointer
